jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – AI Reporting & Insights
jobs.location: Business Office & Sales Office - Madrid, Spain
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Mondelez Digital Services (MDS) is looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own our Agentic Insights Generation Layer — the AI-powered analytical core that turns raw market data into decision-ready recommendations for the business.
You will be accountable for a suite of autonomous AI agents that continuously monitor and interpret the company's key topline business drivers, and translate them into clear, actionable insight for stakeholders across global, regional, and local teams.
This is an agentic reasoning system that helps the business understand how it is performing against the categories in which we compete, and turn that understanding into better commercial decisions, faster and with less manual analysis.
More about this role

Key Responsibilities
- Own the Agentic Insights Generation Layer end-to-end , defining the product vision, roadmap, and architecture for a multi-agent system that autonomously analyzes topline business drivers (distribution, price/promo, trend & category performance) and surfaces prioritized, decision-ready recommendations.
- Translate business questions into agent capabilities — working Insights & Analytics teams to encode how the business evaluates performance, positioning, and innovation into the reasoning logic, prompts, and workflows of the AI agents.
- Collaborate with stakeholders across global, regional, and local teams to gather requirements, define use cases, and translate business needs into technical product scope for AI-based reporting, insights, and recommendation generation.
- Own and maintain the product roadmap , feature backlog, and documentation, including user stories, agent workflow specifications, data requirements, and evaluation criteria for insight quality.
- Champion adoption of agentic AI and insights capabilities across the organization, driving change management, training, and communication so commercial and marketing teams trust and act on AI-generated recommendations.
- Maintain deep fluency in the AI/agentic technology stack — data pipelines, model orchestration, agent-to-agent workflows, and tool integrations — to make sound architecture and prioritization decisions in partnership with engineering.
- Define and own success metrics for the insights layer, including decision impact, insight accuracy, latency, and user trust — and iterate the product based on measured outcomes.
- Manage product budget, delivery cadence, and vendor/partner relationships , ensuring all work meets performance, security, privacy, and responsible-AI standards.

We Are Looking For Candidates With
- Proven experience leading data and AI-oriented projects within a CPG context , ideally spanning sales and/or marketing — you understand how CPG companies make investment, pricing, and innovation decisions.
- Direct experience designing or delivering agentic AI/workflow solutions — multi-agent orchestration, autonomous reasoning pipelines, or LLM-based decision-support systems
- Proven AI product management experience , owning the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery through delivery and continuous improvement.
- Ability to set strategic direction and drive execution through cross-functional collaboration, proactively identifying gaps and improvement opportunities.
- Strong Agile delivery experience : prioritizing backlogs, writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and managing delivery cadences.
- Excellent communication skills , able to translate complex AI/ML and agentic concepts into business language for non-technical commercial and marketing stakeholders, and vice versa.
- Intellectual curiosity and a bias for experimentation , staying current on emerging agentic AI patterns, evaluation methods, and regulatory developments.

Nice to Have
- Certifications in AI/ML, prompt engineering, or autonomous agent design.
- Familiarity with cloud environments (GCP, Azure, AWS) and the Databricks platform (Unity Catalog, Genie, etc.).
- Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) or similar multi-agent tooling.
- Experience defining and tracking AI product metrics such as accuracy, latency, user trust, hallucination rate, and business decision impact.
- Prior exposure to syndicated market data providers (Nielsen, Circana/IRI, Kantar) and RGM/trade promotion management platforms.

Relocation Support Available?

No Relocation support available

jobs.title: Product Manager - Digital Asset Management (DAM) - Barcelona based (Global role)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.

You support system activities in a specific process area, including analysis, design, and overseeing the implementation of system changes to increase effectiveness and efficiency aligned with corporate strategies.

How you will contribute

Working in a cross-functional environment, you will collaborate closely with global and regional teams to optimize SAP and integrated non-SAP systems and processes, translating business needs into functional requirements. You will define what the capability must achieve and how success will be measured and ensure that solutions are robust, strategically aligned and efficient to deliver and maintain. To succeed in this role, you must understand integration points in an integrated ERP system (i.e. SAP ECC), standalone, SAAS, and control systems and effectively interact with senior management from business and technology disciplines to keep them informed and to present highly complex solutions.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in :
- Technical skills and business acumen to support the development of technology and capability changes
- Knowledge of systems and business processes
- IT solution architecture
- Influencing others based on earned respect and experience
- Negotiating with others for action or buy-in to maximize win-win outcomes and ensuring that appropriate “lessons learned” are shared
- Analytical and problem-solving abilities
- Working in manufacturing environment
- Managing multi-country stakeholders

More about this role

Mondelēz Global MDS (IT) Team is looking for energetic and experienced people with strong strategic and technically savvy Product Manager to own and scale our Digital Asset Management (DAM) ecosystem . In this role, you will lead the vision, strategy and execution for a platform that serves as the single source of truth for all our visual content (rich media, brand assets, product assets) and the workflows around it.
You will sit at the intersection of creative production, marketing, and technology teams ensuring our internal teams and external partners can seamlessly create, organise, search, and distribute content globally.

How you will contribute
- Define the DAM Strategy : Own the product roadmap, prioritizing features that improve ingestion, AI-driven tagging, metadata modelling, and rights management.
- Optimize Workflows & Integrations: Deeply integrate the DAM tool with our broader marketing tech stack
- Champion Metadata & Search: Partner with taxonomists and content teams to build intuitive search experiences, taxonomy structures, and automated AI metadata tagging.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the bridge between creative directors, marketing leads, legal (rights management), and technology to balance user experience with scalability.
- Data-Driven Insights: Track platform adoption, storage utilization, and asset reuse metrics to continuously optimize the product experience and demonstrate ROI.
- Collect requirements from regional and local teams & translating business requirements to technical scope
- Collaborates with stakeholders and different teams (global, regional and local) from the organization to collect data, identify gaps, conduct ideation session and create functional requirements.
- Create, manage and keep up to date product roadmaps, feature backlogs and product documentation such as user stories, use cases, user flows, logic flows, and functional specifications
- Collaborates with Architecture team, Application/Platform, Technical Product teams to make right technology choices and ensure smooth delivery of features
- Be very creative and curious and make regular contributions for new product ideas based on market need, usage conclusions and industry trends
- Champion user adoption
- Understand the technology stack, dependencies between applications and how the data flows between them
- Partners with Integration Lead and other Product Leads across PXM (Product Experience Management) space
- Accountable for Product quality (defines Product goals and KPIs, ongoing support), Product budget and ensures all work implemented with quality, meeting performance, security & privacy needs

What you will bring
- Min 8-10 years' experience in Technical Product Management roles
- Previous at least 3+ years of experience in DAM area (ideally in CPG / FMCG industry), PXM/ PIM space, Media management space.
- Experience in Adobe AEM is a plus
- Strong understanding of asset lifecycles, metadata, taxonomy structures, schema design, and rights/permissions governance.
- Experience or strong interest in leveraging AI/ML tools for automated image/video tagging, transcription, and smart cropping.
- Experience in establishing and operating IT Products, Martech experiences
- Experience with Agile development methodologies
- Experience in managing technical teams (internal or external) to achieve Win-Win partnerships
- Ability to understand, explain and present technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Ability to set strategic direction and drive execution through collaboration with a cross-functional team.
- Strong collaboration skills, proactively sharing observations & improvements areas, problem solving skills, attention to details, can-do attitude
- Curiosity and energy to continually learn new marketing technologies and stay apprised of security and regulatory changes.
- Fluent in English

Nice to have:
- Certifications in ITIL, SAFe Agile, Adobe AEM.

No Relocation support available
Business Unit Summary

At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.
We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as Oreo , belVita and LU biscuits; Cadbury Dairy Milk , Milka and Toblerone chocolate; Sour Patch Kids candy and Trident gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum.
Our 80,000 makers and bakers are located in more than 80 countries and we sell our products in over 150 countries around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.

jobs.title: Product Owner, IAM Sr. Manager, Identity Governance & Life Cycle
jobs.location: East Hanover, New Jersey, United States
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.

Mondelez International is hiring IAM Senior Manager & Product Owner - Identity Governance & Lifecycle Management

Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced and visionary IAM Senior Manager & Product Owner – for Identity Governance & Lifecycle Management function within the Identity & Access Management (IAM) team. This critical role will be responsible for defining and executing the global strategy for identity governance, ensuring robust access controls, streamlining identity lifecycle processes, and automating identity-related controls at scale. The ideal candidate will bring extensive leadership experience across various IGA technologies and a deep understanding of multiplatform environments. You will drive innovation, enhance our security posture, and optimize identity-related operational efficiencies.

Key Responsibilities
- Define, lead, and execute the strategic multi-year roadmap for Identity Governance & Lifecycle Management aligning with enterprise security and business objectives.

- Drive the maturity of Identity Governance & Lifecycle management capabilities, including access certifications, RBAC, access request workflows, and identity analytics.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for all internal and external audit engagements related to Identity Governance & Lifecycle management, ensuring robust controls are documented, tested, and effectively managed.

- Establish and own the continuous improvement of Identity governance capabilities including continuous JML processes, access certifications, role mining, application onboarding, and access analytics

- Own all aspects of Identity Governance & Lifecycle management including architecture, design, implementation, and continuous optimization, ensuring robust functionality and automation for core capabilities.

- Enhance and optimize policies, standards, and procedures for the full identity lifecycle for workforce identities, non-human identities and external identities.

- Manage and enhance robust access governance processes, including regular access reviews and certifications.

- Collaborate with stakeholders to define and implement effective Role-Based Access Control and Attribute Based Access models.

- Collaborate effectively with various stakeholders across IT, security, audit, legal, and business units to understand requirements, manage expectations, and deliver solutions.

- Ensure all Identity Governance & Lifecycle management processes and controls meet regulatory requirements (e.g., SOX, GDPR) and internal security policies.

- Identify and mitigate risks associated with identity and access, contributing to the overall cyber security posture.

- Lead, mentor, and empower a high-performing global team of IAM specialists, fostering a culture of innovation, excellence, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree (Preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field).

- 15+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management preferably in Identity Governance & Lifecycle Management.

- 7+ years of proven leadership and management experience in Identity Governance & Lifecycle Management, leading technical teams and strategic initiatives.

- Extensive hands-on and leadership experience with IIQ and ISC, including architecture, engineering, and operations.

- Experience with other IAM solutions (e.g. Ping Identity, Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD, CyberArk) is highly desirable.

- Demonstrated experience with multiplatform IGA environments, integrating with diverse enterprise applications, directories (e.g., Active Directory, Azure AD), and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).

- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced global environment.

Preferred Certifications
- CISSP, CISM, CISA or equivalent cybersecurity certification

- Microsoft Identity / Azure security certifications

- IAM-specific certifications

- SailPoint or equivalent IGA platform-based certifications

Salary and Benefits:

The base salary range for this position is $140,300 to $192,940; the exact salary depends on several factors such as experience, skills, education and location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a highly competitive bonus program with possibility for overachievement based on performance and company results.

In addition, Mondelez International offers the following benefits: health insurance, wellness and family support programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education related programs, paid holidays and vacation time. Some of these benefits have eligibility requirements. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.

No Relocation support available

Here, we produce our well-loved household favorites to provide our consumers with the right snack, at the right moment, made the right way. We have corporate offices, sales, manufacturing and distribution locations throughout the U.S. to ensure our iconic brands—including Oreo and  Chips Ahoy! cookies, Ritz, Wheat Thins and Triscuit crackers, and Swedish Fish and Sour Patch Kids confectionery products —are close at hand for our consumers across the country.
